description: This file defines an IronControlState behavior in Polymer, which manages focus and disabled states for custom elements.

methods.name: _focusBlurHandler
methods.description: Handles focus and blur events to update internal focus state and fire synthetic events in Shadow DOM context.

methods.name: _disabledChanged
methods.description: Observer for disabled property; updates ARIA attribute, pointer events, and tab index accordingly.

methods.name: _changedControlState
methods.description: Calls additional control state change handler if defined.
